overview.description: The MicroSectors Gold Miners 3X Leveraged ETN (GDXU) is an exchange-traded note that is based on the S-Network MicroSectors Gold Miners index. The fund provides 3x daily leveraged exposure to a market-cap weighted index comprised of two gold miners ETFs. GDXU was launched on Dec 7, 2020 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
